Gacrux.efbfe52d.actualRenderText: <A woman aged105. Ancient, dry, papery voice with age-cracked creak, light breathy quaver and frail breath support. Soft low-mid register. Unhurried short phrases with small natural pauses. Warm, wry rural English manner; perfectly lucid and self-possessed. Clearly very elderly, not a young actress speaking slowly, not the firm resonant guard captain. No cartoon witch or theatrical croak. Speak only the dialogue.> Sit down, dearie. I’ve waited a hundred years, I can wait while you sit.
